title: Quantum Gibbs sampling through the detectability lemma
summary: Gibbs state preparation is an important subroutine in quantum computing. In this work we use the detectability lemma to improve Gibbs state preparation. Specifically, we design new Gibbs state preparation methods that do not rely on simulating Lindbladian evolution, thus avoiding the overhead from it. For local Lindbladians consisting of $M$ terms, this approach reduces the cost by a factor of $O(M)$.
